```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The Republican budget plan would end Medicare as it is currently known.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats adamantly oppose any efforts to privatize or voucherize Medicare.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will not ask seniors to pay thousands of dollars more every year while their Medicare benefits decrease in value.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats believe that Medicare is a sacred compact with seniors.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Nearly 50 million older Americans and Americans with disabilities rely on Medicare each year.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The new health care law makes Medicare stronger by adding new benefits, fighting fraud, and improving care for patients.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Over 10 years, the new health care law will save the average Medicare beneficiary $4,200.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"President Obama is already leading the most successful crackdown on health care fraud ever, having already recovered $10 billion from health care scams.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Reforms to the health care fraud crackdown will be built upon, and Medicare's guarantees will not be eliminated.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The health care law is closing the gap in prescription drug coverage known as the “doughnut hole.”",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"More than five million seniors have already saved money—an average of $600 last year—due to the closing of the “doughnut hole.”",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The “doughnut hole” will be closed for good by 2020.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
